evidence.quote: Accordingly, the aim of this study is to generate a comprehensive dataset of complete adenovirus genomes representing the breadth of viral subtypes circulating in Russia.
Samples were collected within the framework of the Global Influenza Hospital Surveillance Network (GIHSN) [19] during two consecutive years, 2023 and 2024.
